verdict.rationale: Smithery manages OAuth flows for MCP connections, so white-labeling that flow is a fair question for this product. The evidence points the other way: Smithery says no client IDs or secrets need configuring because it maintains its own OAuth apps. Nothing documents custom branding or bring-your-own OAuth credentials, and the connection services were shut down on October 31, 2026.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can white-label the authorization flow with my own branding and my own OAuth app credentials
